artists.source_line: 🎉 *INTERNATIONAL GALA DANCE BOAT “REGINA DANUBIA meets DDF”* 🎉 Germany Dance Festival

features.rationale: The description says the weekend combines intensive workshops, and lists Friday and Saturday workshop sessions.

features.quote: A 4-hour dance cruise on the Danube
features.rationale: The event includes a four-hour dance cruise on the Danube river.

features.quote: where you dance on a real Danube riverboat
features.rationale: Dancing takes place on a riverboat during the Danube dance boat trip.
An Afterparty from 9:30 PM to 12:00 AM is listed after the boat trip.
A list of recommended hotels is given, and accommodation is not stated as part of the pass.
